selections.heading: Testing Posture
selections.text: ALWAYS treat current executable test and coverage results as authoritative when historical summaries contain stale counts

selections.heading: Testing Posture
selections.text: ALWAYS include security and performance instructions when explicit NFR or privacy risks require them, even under Standard strategy

selections.heading: Testing Posture
selections.text: ALWAYS report provisioned environment checks as outstanding evidence until they are executed against real integrations
